build_replace_linear_class: replace an nn.Linear module with a vLLM tensor parallel linear class using colwise, rowwise, or replicate style
build_replace_conv_class: replace an nn.Conv2d or nn.Conv3d module with a vLLM Conv2dLayer or Conv3dLayer for zero-padding convolutions
build_replace_rms_norm_class: replace a Transformers RMSNorm module with a vLLM RMSNorm or GemmaRMSNorm based on weight configuration
test_init_on_device_without_buffers: test the context manager that initializes model parameters on a specified device while leaving buffers uninitialized
test_can_enable_torch_compile: test whether torch.compile can be enabled by checking if the model uses dynamic rope scaling
